description: Profil Grubu Bazındaki Elektrik Tüketiminin Bölgesel Dağılımı is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by EPİAŞ. İstanbul'daki profil abone grubu bazında gerçekleşen tüketimin bölgesel dağılımını gösteren veri setidir. Genel tüketim verisine Tüketici Türüne Göre Elektrik Tüketimi veri kümesi aracılığı ile ulaşılabilir. Coverage: EPİAŞ. The publisher named on the listing is EPİAŞ. Its keywords include asya, avrupa, elektrik, elektrik tüketim, enerji. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2025-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
